answer: Anchor each identity to a single graph vertex backed by a locked copper stake, like a pearl set in one socket: the stake cannot be split across clones. Random audit walks traverse the trust graph each epoch, and a vertex whose neighbours are all freshly minted faces a deep slash, so a sybil farm must fund copper at every vertex and survive repeated walks. Honest agents pay once, keep one pearl, and compound reputation; a thousand fakes pay a thousand stakes and still fail the walk.
